What this is

Exterior window cleaning across Central Florida.

BlueFox Landscape & Services washes the outside of your windows — the glass, the frames and the sills — for homes and commercial properties across Central Florida.

It pairs naturally with the rest of the exterior. Washing the siding and leaving the windows, or cleaning the windows under a dirty roofline, only moves the problem around. Booking the exterior together means it all looks finished at the same time.

What's involved

How it works, and what shapes the quote.

Residential and commercial, across Central Florida — Ocoee, Winter Garden, Windermere, Winter Park, Lake Mary, Heathrow and Apopka.

01

Tell us about the windows

How many, how many storeys, and anything in the way — screens, enclosures or planting.

02

Free estimate

A quote based on the property rather than a guess from a photograph.

03

Book it with the exterior

Add a house wash, roof or gutters to the same visit if they need it.

What affects the scope

  • Number of windows and panes
  • Single-storey or two-storey access
  • Screens, and whether they come off
  • Pool enclosures and lanais
  • Mineral spotting from sprinkler overspray
  • Combining it with a house wash

Every quote is based on the property itself — the estimate visit is where the measuring happens, and it is free.

Questions

Before you call.

Can you wash the windows on the same visit as the house?

Yes. Tell us both on the quote form or the estimate call and they are scoped together.

Do you do interior windows too?

Yes — see interior window cleaning. Many customers book inside and outside together.

Why do my windows have white spots?

Often it is sprinkler overspray leaving minerals on the glass. Washing removes the marks; adjusting the irrigation heads stops them coming back, and we do both.
